public_rationale: The research makes parts of the explanation plausible, but does not settle the broad causal attribution. LaMDA improves with external knowledge and targeted training, while other work finds useful implicit state representations in text-trained models. Neither result establishes how inadequate reference, cognitive models and compositionality contribute across all three consequences. Evidence that the problems exist cannot by itself establish this explanation.
limitations: The search is not an exhaustive systematic review.
Retrieval-based groundedness is an imperfect operational substitute for linguistic reference.
Evidence from BART and T5 does not automatically establish mechanisms in GPT-3 or LaMDA.

statement.excerpt: In our view, inadequate attention to these three factors has serious consequences, including:
statement.document_title: Three ideas from linguistics that everyone in AI should know

from_speaker: inadequate attention to these three factors
our_interpretation: Read in context, this attributes a substantial causal contribution to inadequate reference, cognitive models and compositionality across the three listed problems.
It does not say that each factor independently causes every problem, or that these are the only causes.
Operational interventions may approximate the linguistic concepts, but that correspondence must be justified rather than assumed.
The claim concerns models available at the post, not a forecast about subsequent models.
criteria.support_condition: Controlled interventions or comparably strong causal evidence connect the specified deficits to substantial coherence, truthfulness and harmful-speech problems, with suitable controls for other changes.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable causal tests establish that the specified deficits do not materially contribute to the listed problems, with enough coverage to challenge the general attribution.

evidence.explanation: The researchers recover and manipulate entity-state representations in BART and T5, while acknowledging their errors. This complicates an absence-based explanation but does not determine whether inadequate versions of those capabilities cause the three listed problems.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: Controlled studies on the historical model class that define and vary the proposed capabilities, measure all three consequences, and separate their effects from supervision, scale and decoding changes.
